title: 第19章 告知叶兴怀第20章 潜在的危机
content_zh:
“我就知道你会做出这个选择，也不枉我推荐你去。”
“我也是纠结了许久，最终在父亲和母亲的帮助下，才明白了自己的想法。”
“看来伯父伯母也是做了一个很重要的决定吧。”
“是的，母亲一开始还不太愿意我去。”
“我能理解，毕竟外门弟子还是有很大的凶险的，父母都不想看到自己的儿女出现意外。”
与叶飞扬闲聊了一下，分享了下自己的内心波动，叶非凡问出一个关键问题。
“飞扬大哥，我们什么时候出发呢？”
“十日后怎么样，不过你和我一起去的事情不能让其他人知晓，所以，十日后你事先在城外东面的分叉路口等我吧，那里有一个岔路，十日后的午时，我们在那里集合碰头，你可以稍微隐蔽下，等我到了后再出现，然后我们一起前往灵霄宗。”
“好，我知道了，不过这个事情连二哥也不能告诉吗？”对于帮助自己不少的叶兴怀，叶非凡还是不太想隐瞒。
“嗯。兴怀和凝霜可以告知，其他年轻一辈就不要说了。”对于叶兴怀和叶凝霜，叶飞扬似乎也不打算隐瞒。
“好的，那我知道了，飞扬大哥，我这就先回去准备准备了。”
……
和叶飞扬告辞后，叶非凡看着天色已经暗淡，便来到父母这边，准备和父母一起吃晚饭。
“父亲，我已经和飞扬大哥说好了，十日后的午时，我会在城外东面的分叉路口和大哥碰面后一起前往灵霄宗。”
“嗯，那这些时间你多过来陪陪你母亲吧，毕竟去了灵霄宗，什么时候能回来一趟都不知道了。”
“好，那我每天晚上都过来和你们一起吃晚饭，白天就去商铺里面待着。”
“不过你小子，不声不响的就练气6重了啊，看来平常一直在刻苦修炼。”
叶虎之前就看出来了叶非凡的修为，但是白天的事情太重要，就没说，而此刻正好可以用来转移话题。
“啊，非凡你都练气6重了，这速度也不比家族里的其他人慢了，值得庆祝，来来来，多吃点。”孙素素听到叶虎的话后，脸上顿时高兴不少，连忙给叶非凡夹菜。
“都是父亲买的固灵佩和大哥给的微型聚灵阵的功劳，我才能修炼速度这么快，不过现在没有灵石了，以后的修炼速度肯定会慢下来。”

“不要急，只要赶上了大部队，以后修炼都有希望的。”
叶虎也积极的喂鸡汤给叶非凡喝。
和叶虎孙素素愉快的吃完饭后，叶飞扬便回到房间继续修炼。
“大哥说灵霄宗内有不止一个元婴老怪，这样的配置都不能在阳州域称王称霸，有点离谱啊。“
“以这个已知条件来看，说明元婴老怪还不能算是最高战力？这星越皇朝得有多强，真是不敢想，化神？合体？还是更高？“
“不过按照一般得网络小说中描写，主角一开始都是加入的低级宗门啊，老祖撑死金丹期的那种，这样才好开始混。“
“我这从新手村出去直接就到有元婴老怪的宗门，这是不是跨度大了点。“
“嘶……这越想越有点不对劲啊，我这级别才多少，连个外挂都没有，就直接出新手村了？还直接去高级地图练级。“
“靠，越想越有点后悔，那天被父亲忽悠的有点上头了，现在冷静下来一想，实在是冲动了点，不会过去没多久没噶了吧。”
“要不要去跟叶飞扬说下不去了，生命最宝贵。“
“冷静，也非凡，冷静，不要太悲观，那边好歹有叶飞扬罩着，应该没有那么可怕。“
“可是叶飞扬也还没有到筑基期，按照他的说法，还没有成为真正的修士，这能罩得住我吗？“
“也许这灵霄宗没有那么勾心斗角，是一个和谐宗门呢？这种宗门也不是没有。“
“希望如此，老天爷啊，保佑下，不要太残酷啊，想必你要安排一个人穿越也不容易吧。“
坐在房内的叶非凡胡思乱想了半天，对于当初答应去灵霄宗的事情有点后悔，但后面又不停的安慰自己，属实是没有外挂的普通人真实想法了，突出一个纠结。
算了算了，还有几天就要出发了，抓紧时间要外挂吧，也许这几天就下发了呢。
“系统你好“
“系统你在吗”
“系统你回话啊“
果然没有回应。

“系统啊系统，只剩9天我就要去新地图练级了，我劝你不要不知好歹，不要逼我到时候跪下来求你。“
在这样的纠结情绪中，叶非凡也失去了修炼的心情，便倒头睡去。
“睡了睡了，明天去找二哥聊聊吧。“
content_en:
"I knew you would make this choice, and I recommend you go in vain."
"I struggled with it for a long time, and finally, with the help of my father and mother, I finally understood my thoughts."
"It seems that my uncle and aunt have also made a very important decision."
"Yes, my mother was reluctant for me to go at first."
"I can understand. After all, outer disciples are still in great danger. Parents don't want to see their children have accidents."
After chatting with Ye Feiyang and sharing his inner fluctuations, Ye Feifan asked a key question.
"Brother Feiyang, when will we set off?"
"What about ten days from now? But what you are going with me cannot be known to others. So after ten days, you can wait for me at the fork in the east of the city. There is a fork there. We will meet there at noon ten days later. You can stay a little hidden and wait until I arrive before you show up. Then we will go to Lingxiao Sect together."
"Okay, I understand, but can't you tell even your second brother about this?" Ye Feifan still didn't want to hide it from Ye Xinghuai, who had helped him a lot.
"Yes. Xinghuai and Ningshuang can tell them, but the other younger generations shouldn't say anything." Regarding Ye Xinghuai and Ye Ningshuang, Ye Feiyang didn't seem to want to hide anything.
"Okay, then I understand, Brother Feiyang, I'll go back and get ready."
…
After saying goodbye to Ye Feiyang, Ye Feifan saw that the sky was getting dark, so he came to his parents and prepared to have dinner with them.
"Father, I have made an agreement with Brother Feiyang. At noon ten days later, I will meet him at the fork in the east outside the city and then we will go to Lingxiao Sect together."
"Well, then you should spend more time with your mother. After all, I went to Lingxiao Sect, and I don't know when I can come back."
"Okay, then I'll come over and have dinner with you every night, and I'll stay in the shop during the day."
"But you, kid, have reached the sixth level of qi training without making any noise. It seems that you have been practicing hard."
Ye Hu had seen Ye Fanfan's cultivation before, but the things during the day were too important, so he didn't talk about it, and this moment was just the right time to change the subject.
"Ah, Feifan, you have already reached the sixth level of Qi training. Your speed is no slower than that of other people in the family. It's worth celebrating. Come on, come on, eat more." After hearing Ye Hu's words, Sun Susu's face suddenly became very happy and she quickly picked up food for Ye Feifan.
"It's all thanks to the solid spirit pendant bought by my father and the miniature spirit gathering array given by my elder brother that I can practice so fast. But now that there are no spirit stones, my practice speed will definitely slow down in the future."
"Don't be anxious. As long as you catch up with the large army, there will be hope for your future cultivation."
Ye Hu also actively fed chicken soup to Ye Feifan.
After happily eating with Ye Hu and Sun Susu, Ye Feiyang returned to the room to continue practicing.
"Brother said that there is more than one Yuanying old monster in Lingxiao Sect. Such a configuration cannot dominate the Yangzhou domain. It is a bit outrageous."
"Judging from these known conditions, it means that the old monster Yuanying is not considered to have the highest combat power? I really can't imagine how strong this Xingyue Dynasty is. Transformation into a god? Fusion? Or even higher?"
"However, according to the descriptions in general online novels, the protagonists all join low-level sects at the beginning, the kind where the ancestors are in the golden elixir stage, so that they can start to mix."
"I went directly from Novice Village to the sect with the Yuanying old monster. Isn't this a big span?"
"Hey... the more I think about this, the more something is wrong. I'm only at a certain level, and I don't even have a plug-in, so I just left the novice village? And I went directly to the advanced map to level up."
"Damn, the more I think about it, the more I regret it. I was a little fooled by my father that day. Now that I calm down and think about it, I was really a little impulsive. It won't be long ago."
"Do you want to tell Ye Feiyang that you can't go on anymore? LifeThe most precious. "
"Calm down, extraordinary, calm down, don't be too pessimistic, at least there is Ye Feiyang covering you, so it shouldn't be that scary. "
"But Ye Feiyang has not yet reached the foundation building stage. According to him, he has not yet become a true monk. Can this protect me? "
“Perhaps this Lingxiao Sect is not so cunning and is a harmonious sect? There is no such sect. "
"I hope so. God, please don't be too cruel. It must not be easy for you to arrange for someone to travel through time. "
Sitting in the room, Ye Feifan thought wildly for a long time. He felt a little regretful about agreeing to go to Lingxiao Sect, but later he kept comforting himself that it was really the true thoughts of ordinary people without cheats, which highlighted a tangle.
Forget it, we are leaving in a few days, so hurry up and get the plug-in, maybe it will be released within a few days.
"Hello system"
"System, are you here?"
"System, please reply."
Sure enough, there was no response.
"System, system, there are only 9 days left for me to go to the new map to level up. I advise you not to be ungrateful and don't force me to kneel down and beg you. "
In such tangled emotions, Ye Feifan also lost his mood for cultivation and fell asleep.
"Go to sleep, let's talk to my second brother tomorrow. "
